paragraphs: RollKall sells an off-duty work management platform with separate experiences for law enforcement agencies, officers, and the clients who hire them. Agencies post off-duty jobs with requirements and compliance rules, and officers are matched based on eligibility, availability, and department policy. Invoices are generated from clock-in and clock-out data, payments are routed to officers, and 1099s are handled digitally. An agency can run the platform itself or have RollKall run it as a managed service.

Officers use a mobile app to browse available shifts, view pay rates and locations, accept jobs, and clock in and out from their phones. Payment options include WeeklyPay, PrePay, and InstantPay, which lets officers access earnings immediately after completing a job. Clients and vendors request officers through a branded client portal with approval workflows, automated invoicing, and electronic payment processing. The company reports 85%+ officer adoption within the first 30 days across its deployments.

Published case studies cover the Irving Police Department and the Paulding County Sheriff's Office. Testimonials on the site come from the Cincinnati Police Department, the Prince George's County Police Department, the Randall County Sheriff's Office, and the St. Charles County Police Department.

quote.text: Our mission is to empower the agencies, coordinators, and off-duty public safety professionals who protect and support their communities every day.
